elements.name: two young men seen from behind
walking side by side into lit street
taller young man in denim jacket
blue and white minibuses with headlights on

wrong_setting: Large full-size city buses and generic East Asian-looking tower blocks read more like a Chinese or Korean city than the edge of Addis Ababa.
anatomy: The two figures are fused into one body: a taller head and shoulders rise directly out of the shorter man's back, sharing one torso, one pair of legs and a backpack strap.
notes: Regenerate with two separate men seen from behind, walking side by side: the shorter one in a dark jacket with a backpack and the taller one in a denim jacket. Swap the big buses for blue-and-white Addis minibuses.
